agents.name: Cognition Assistant
agents.description: Routes each message to a capability: idea analysis against the scaffolding templates (/idea), questions about the templates (/ask), or a clarifying question (/clarify). Read-only.

commands.name: /idea
commands.description: Analyze an idea: which templates cover what, and what is missing

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: A question about the templates, the research or a previous answer

commands.name: /clarify
commands.description: Help me put into words what I want
